svg.aria-label: The three Greek special tax regimes: 5A, 5B and 5C
svg.text: The three Greek special tax regimes: 5A, 5B and 5C
All foreign income. €500,000 invested within three years
All foreign income too, not only the pension
Only income arising in Greece itself
The bar is the term in tax years. 5A starts in the first year applied for, 5B in the next.
Every figure checked against a primary source on 28 August 2026
